articles.title: Binance joins STOP THE TRAFFIK in anti-human trafficking effort
articles.snippet: The partnership expands Binance’s compliance efforts by providing intelligence and training to help detect cryptocurrency activity tied to human trafficking and child exploitation.

articles.title: Kakao taps Circle to explore won stablecoin payment infrastructure
articles.snippet: Kakao Group and Circle signed an MOU to explore won stablecoin payments, remittances, merchant settlement and tokenized financial services.

articles.title: Arbitrum Perp DEX AFX Trade Drained of $24M, Offers Hacker 30% to Return It
articles.snippet: The exploit hit a custody bridge AFX operates rather than the Arbitrum network itself, with the stolen funds quickly moved to Ethereum.
